data.reason: Independent manual content review of this standalone artifact against every retained original requirement.
data.rationale: The synthetic 1:5 table and weighted_accuracy implementation, followed by a new independent 1:4 hand/code task, correctly weight by truth, include all evaluated rows in the denominator and reverse model rankings. Prerequisites, learning and general assessment behavior are met. The unchanged original Radar-specific principle requires w(-1)=1 and other labels=50, and its practice instantiates non-background label 2 with an explicit prediction-vector comparison. The student notebook instead uses a binary B/T contract; those original cases are not supplied. The linked source and separate teacher caveat do not replace student material.
